description: Source code implementing tensor data type conversions and DLPack interoperability functions within the ATen namespace, used in PyTorch for tensor device and type conversions.

classes.name: ATenDLMTensor
classes.description: Template struct for managing ATen tensors with DL managed tensor context.

methods.name: deleter
methods.description: Deletes ATenDLMTensor object, used as custom deleter for DL managed tensors.

methods.name: fillVersion
methods.description: Fills version info for DLManagedTensorVersioned, no-op for other types.

methods.name: toDLPackImpl
methods.description: Converts ATen tensor to DLManagedTensor or DLManagedTensorVersioned.

methods.name: fromDLPackImpl
methods.description: Constructs ATen tensor from DLManagedTensor or DLManagedTensorVersioned.
